name: PGC 42871 (Hubble)
blurb: PGC 42871, a galaxy wrapped in shells of stars, seen by Hubble.
label: pgc42871-hubble
story: Delicate shells of stars bloom outward from PGC 42871, a rare sight around a galaxy of its kind. They hint at past collisions with other galaxies, perhaps including a former spiral.

claims.text: ESO 381-12 is also known as PGC 42871
Delicate shells bloom outward, rare for its type
PGC 42871 is an elliptical galaxy surrounded by shells of stars
It has been in at least two collisions, one possibly with a former spiral
Program lists PGC42871 as an elliptical with shell features
